title: Settings
savedNextRun: Runs already in progress aren't affected. The new settings apply from the next run.
emptyHint: You haven't saved any settings yet. Defaults are in use.

sectionDescription.appearance: Choose the language and colors of the screen.
sectionDescription.common: Defaults that every agent inherits (execution backend, model, system prompt, and so on). Teams, agents, and nodes can override them. Changes apply from the next run.
sectionDescription.chat: How the chat screen behaves. A team can override these settings.
sectionDescription.delegation: The sub-agent method can't go deeper than 1 because of an SDK limit. Other delegation methods use the depth.
sectionDescription.mergeRules: Override the rule used for each field when layers are merged. Changing a rule can widen the values.
sectionDescription.interaction: How runs wait for questions, approvals, and review requests.
sectionDescription.usage: Choose which sources the usage screen shows and how.
sectionDescription.logs: Reads and indexes logs from other tools and this app's run history. Source files are only read, never changed. Server values such as the collection interval and retention period are set by whoever installs the server and can't be changed here.
sectionDescription.shortcuts: The screen sets the default keys, and the keys you set here win. Only the entries you list change.
sectionDescription.notifications: These are workspace settings, so they apply to every browser that connects to this server. Each browser asks for its own permission.
sectionDescription.projects: Chat, runs, and logs work only inside registered folders. Changes in this section apply right away, without a save button.
sectionDescription.install: Install the app from your browser to use it in its own window.
sectionDescription.modules: The state of the features and integrations installed on this server. This is read-only. Whoever installs the server turns them on or off in the settings file or with server start options.
sectionDescription.server: These values change only in the server settings file. Changing them from the web could break the local-only rule.
sectionDescription.versionsUi: Choose which keys the version comparison screen uses to name list items such as nodes and edges. If you leave it empty, the default list is used.
sectionDescription.logTaxonomy: Set category names, descriptions, visibility, colors, and tones. Collected logs aren't affected; only how they're shown changes.
sectionDescription.architecture: Choose and edit the rules (profiles) the architecture map uses to draw boxes and connections.
sectionDescription.memory: Set the scope kinds, cleanup rules, and secret handling for the memory that agents and people share.
sectionDescription.sdd: Set defaults such as the task syntax, verification sources, and secret checks for spec documents. Each spec can override them on its Rules tab.
sectionDescription.versions: Each time you save settings, a version is kept. You can compare with earlier versions and revert.

appearance.themeHelp: Colors for this browser. System follows your OS setting and updates as soon as the OS changes.

language.label: Language
language.help: Language of the text on screen. Your names, notes, and prompts are never translated.
language.autoFallback: Your browser language ({code}) isn't available, so {name} is used.
language.unavailableHelp: The saved language isn't available. Automatic is used instead.
language.serverTextOriginal: Text from the server (setting descriptions, kind names) appears in its original language.
language.serverTextFailed: Couldn't load the server text for this language. Only the app text changed.
language.saveFailed: Language changed, but saving it to the server failed. It may revert the next time you open the app.
